Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity horizontal desktop website section screenshot, 16:9, approximately 1920x1080, edge-to-edge interface without browser chrome or device mockup. This belongs to JEAN / 金子, a Chinese writer, podcast host, hiker and bar owner. Art direction: an adult illustrated travel journal, refined editorial typography and tactile hand-painted landscape, spacious composition, warm off-white paper #f3f1e8, dark forest ink #233a31, vermilion #df452c accents, muted sky blue, consistent clean modern sans-serif English and highly legible Chinese type. Retain the referenced woman's likeness, short dark hair, black sunglasses, mustard beanie, vermilion jacket, large sky-blue expedition backpack, yellow-green trousers and dark boots. She is an illustrated guide, not a photoreal model or a childish chibi. Landscape should echo the brush-rendered reference. No SaaS cards, floating pills, neon gradients, dashboards, fake metrics, lorem ipsum, watermarks. Crisp readable website text. One section only, no multi-screen montage.
SECTION 1 OF 3: HOMEPAGE HERO. A beautifully composed illustrated landscape across the full width, forest emerging from bottom-left, ochre rolling hills and a winding trail crossing foreground into distant blue snowy peaks to the right; atmospheric blank pale sky in upper central area makes typography very clear. Small top-left wordmark 'JEAN / 金子', top-right slim navigation '故事   原野人生   酒吧   足迹   近况'. Central-left editorial name 'JEAN' in very large elegant dark sans serif, '金子' adjacent smaller. Under this, exact statement in readable three lines: 'I enter different worlds, try things myself, and figure out how people and systems actually work.' Then exact Chinese line, can wrap in two lines: '用真实的经历，打开不同的世界，并理解人和系统如何真实运转。' Below one vermilion rectangular button 'Read my stories' and an understated text link 'See what I’m doing now'. The reference woman walks through lower-right foreground, approximately 45 percent frame height, whole body visible and naturally on trail; do not let her cover any text. Most upper area remains calm and airy; landscape fills lower 40 percent. The winding route exits lower edge to imply scroll exploration. This must feel like an elegant interactive personal website, not a tourism ad.

Top-left small chapter label '04 /', followed by large heading 'Places That Changed Me' and short Chinese subtitle '那些改变了我的地方'. On a pale paper background, a softly painted imaginary hiking route traverses a large snow mountain panorama across the middle, with three distinct peaks and restrained pine forest at left. This is an artistic narrative map, not a geographically accurate map. Three elegant readable location labels anchored on the trail: '尼色峨 · 5563m', '冈仁波齐 · 54km', '尼泊尔 ACT · 122km'. Use reference woman small on route at lower center, approximately 19 percent image height. Bottom-left a restrained featured editorial story with title '每个人都在转自己的山' and thin arrow link '读这段旅程 ↗'. Bottom-right a generously sized rectangular snowy mountain photographic insert based on the second reference photo, without thick card chrome, approximately quarter frame width. At top-right a simple category navigation '东非 / 广州 / 山野 / 旅行', with 山野 underlined. Clear hierarchy, beautiful generous spacing, the illustrated trail and photo coexist without scrapbook clutter. No invented prose.
